title: Ticket
$comment: Source of the TypeScript twin in frontend/src/types/generated-tickets.ts. Edit this, then run `deploy.sh usecase run business-operations types`; the drift test fails until the twin matches.
description: One ticket in the sample ticketing table.

description.description: Detailed description of the issue or request.

created_by.description: User or agent that created the ticket.

assigned_to.description: Person or team assigned to the ticket.

case_id.description: Related ERP case identity for correlation — opaque; what the case is about lives in the case record's `key`. Built and parsed only via the case_key codec.

response_type.description: Expected response type: 'approval' shows approve/deny buttons, 'free_text' shows a reply textarea.

decided_by.description: OIDC `sub` of the principal who recorded the decision, from the trusted authorizer context. The agent write gate reads it to refuse an approval with no human behind it.

decided_by_groups.description: That principal's group claims at the moment of the decision. The agent write gate requires one of them to be in the pack's `approve_groups` before an approval releases a payment.

comments.description: Chronological list of comments on the ticket.

option.description: The id of the case's decision option the reviewer chose, when the decision was one.
